2425: A spectre, all dressed in black.
Well COUNT your money and your luck!
2426: A drowned and long dead captain stands here, selling boats.
This captain was nibbled at by more sharks than you have eaten pies.
2427: Leatherface is sitting by the table, sewing a human skin cap.
When not making movies about a chainsaw murderer in Texas, Leatherface
creates unique, human skin apparel, which he offers here to sell.
2428: A skeleton watches you calmly, while it skillfully mixes a bloody mary.
A tired looking skeleton who hates trouble in his bar.

Ragged brown hair frames a ghostly, pale face.  Puffy eyelids surround two
sky blue, haunting eyes.  An old, brown robe is wrapped around her frail
frame.  She looks up from her pile of fingers and eyeballs and looks inquiringly
at you, giving you a sickly smile.

2431: A singing, happy demon wanders around, singing about blood and gore.

2432: A gremlin is here, looking for some fresh blood.
The gremlin looks like it is having the time of its life.
2433: A black cat hisses at you.
The black cat is half mad and more than a little mean.
2434: A trick or treater is here.
The trick or treater is dressed in a white sheet, in a bad attempt to pass
as a ghost.  He demands that you give him candy or else!
2435: A zombie is walking around, messing things up.
2436: A witch's broom hovers slightly above the ground here.
Basically a gnarled, yet straight stick, with straw bound to one end.
2437: A skeletal panther crouches, ready to pounce here.
Black bones gleaming, this skeletal panther is a horrendous sight.
2438: A large white wyrm slithers here.
The wyrm is a cross between a large serpent and a small dragon. It is about
10 meters in length, with the body of an enormous white snake, and the head
of a dragon.  Clearly a formidable opponent.
2439: A jet black griffon stands here.
The griffon has recently been broken well enough to ride, though still a bit
rambunctious. He is entirely black, and is a steed worthy of its owner.
2440: A massive undead warhorse stomps noisily here.
This formerly living warhorse is enormous. It was specially bred for knights
to ride to war... which is exactly what ended its glorious life. It is a
mottled grey color, due to the putrificaion of is body. Upon its great barrel
chest, you can still barely make out the coat of arms brand of its owner. This
beast would be a formidable mount in battle.
2441: An enormous fur-covered elephant swings his trunk here.
The prehistoric creature was found in the icy lands to the north.  A group of
necromancers from the guild thawed its carcass and with great magic, returned
it to life.  Ridden into battle, a mastadon would be a difficult steed to stop.

4201: A huge witch is hovering around here, cackling and rubbing her
If you dare to, ask her to heal you.  Be careful not to offend though, or

4202: The Grim Reaper is here looking for souls to bring back to the Netherworld.
The Grim Reaper is waiting for the witching hour so he can collect his souls
and return home with his collection.  He stands nearly 8 feet tall, and is
covered by a huge, black robe and cowl. Two red eyes burn brightly beneath
the hood, and an enormous scythe he holds in his massive boney hand.

2401: This is the center of the square.  It is dominated by the trunk of the biggest

hundred feet tall!  As you look up, you can see some kind of structure
nestles in the branches high above you.  You also see a large portal carved
into the side of the tree, with an unearthly light emanating from within.
Taking a closer look you see a staircase leading down into the mighty tree.
Near the base of a tree is a sign.
There are lit pumpkins around the base of the Oak tree.
